content.comment_body: Hello, If I log inputs I1 to I8 every second, how long will it record before the SD card becomes full or otherwise stops? Best regards, [user_name]

This depends mainly on the SD card's capacity. Each data log file on the card can have up to 20,000 lines. When a log file reaches this limit and there is remaining space on the SD card, a new log file will automatically be created.

analysis.insight_summary: User questions indicate that data logging on [product_name] is restricted by the maximum number of lines in each file rather than only by storage space. The answer clarifies that although SD card size is important, the system imposes a limit per log file, and new logs are created when the previous ones reach this line cap.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects clear details about how long logging can continue and what technical limits cause logging to stop or add new files, hoping for a direct relationship between logging time and available SD card storage.
